propositions: Eight permanent environment and configuration aliases (REBAR_NO_SYNC, COMPACT_THRESHOLD, SCRATCH_BASE_DIR, REBAR_ACLI_TIMEOUT, RECONCILER_ABSENT_GET_BUDGET, REBAR_ID_GUARD_MODE, REBAR_VERIFY_OVERLAP_ENABLED, verify.overlap_enabled) must be reclassified from _permanent to _tomb entries with error behavior and canonical migration messages.
Active parsing and warning paths for the eight deprecated aliases must be removed from _config_sources.py and _config_sections.py/_config_schema.
All functional test consumers must migrate from deprecated alias spellings to canonical replacement names, including stores and conflict resolver tests.
Fail-loud error messages with canonical replacements must be triggered when deprecated aliases are encountered; canonical spellings must parse to identical typed behavior.
Documentation, examples, ADRs, and changelog must reference only canonical spellings; residual deprecated spellings allowed only in dated historical records and error tombstone tests.
